_comment: Engine adapters. Local-first defaults for Apple Silicon (no CUDA); vendor providers are opt-in via tools.local.json (gitignored). No adapter is required for the framework to validate.

translation._comment: `provider: claude` is the LLM-authored route (the create-closed-captions skill fills worksheets). `mt_baseline` is the OPT-IN machine-translation engine for the scripted/manual route (`project autopilot --mt` / `run_pipeline.sh`), which fills worksheets WITHOUT Claude tokens. null = auto-select the first installed MT engine; or pin one of engines/mt.py KNOWN_PROVIDERS (argos|ctranslate2|nllb|opus-mt) in the gitignored tools.local.json. HF is policy-blocked here — stage the MT model offline (OPERATING-GUIDE.md §6). MT-filled `en` still hits the human translation_qa gate; auto_translate targets skip it.

distribution._comment: Phase 6 uploader/promoter adapters. Every platform here is OFF unless BOTH VIDTRANS_PUBLISH_ENABLED=1 (module) and VIDTRANS_EXTERNAL_WRITES=enabled (hook) are set. `sdk` is the Python import probed by `doctor` (absent SDK => graceful PublishDisabled, never a crash). `credentials_ref` names the env-var prefix (see .env.example).
